issues.explanation: The overlay incorrectly characterizes this as an のこと construction. It is the ordinary noun phrase 後のこと, with genitive の, followed by the formal copula である.
issues.suggested_fix: Describe it as a noun phrase meaning “a matter/event later” followed by formal copula である.

issues.explanation: The overlay describes only an attributive verb clause plus quotative と, but the surface also contains the copula だ: [吸う煙草]だと.
issues.suggested_fix: Describe it as an attributive clause modifying 煙草, followed by copula だ and quotative と.
